definitions.gloss: dengaku; miso-glazed grilled food on skewers
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese dish where tofu, eggplant, konnyaku, or other ingredients are skewered and grilled with a sweet miso glaze. Named after a traditional rice-planting dance because the skewered food resembles performers on stilts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{田楽|でんがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{茄子|なす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{田楽|でんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘|あま}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶品|ぜっぴん}→絶品：13811_zeppin⟧だ。
examples.english: Eggplant dengaku is exquisite with the sweetness of the miso.

examples.japanese: ⟦{囲炉裏|いろり}→囲炉裏：12008_irori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{古民家|こみんか}→古民家：11833_kominka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{田楽|でんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だった。
examples.english: The konnyaku dengaku eaten at an old farmhouse with a traditional hearth was exceptionally good.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually preceded by the ingredient name: ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧{田楽|でんがく} (tofu dengaku), {茄子|なす}{田楽|でんがく} (eggplant dengaku), ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧{田楽|でんがく} (konnyaku dengaku). The miso glaze can be white miso, red miso, or a blend, sometimes with added sweetness from sugar or mirin.

COMMON VARIETIES:
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧{田楽|でんがく}: grilled tofu with miso glaze (the classic version)
- {茄子|なす}{田楽|でんがく}: grilled eggplant with miso
- ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧{田楽|でんがく}: grilled konnyaku with miso
- ⟦{里芋|さといも}→里芋：14462_satoimo⟧{田楽|でんがく}: grilled taro with miso

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {田楽|でんがく}⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: dengaku miso (the sweet miso glaze)
- {田楽|でんがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill dengaku
